title: Korsten Soup Kitchen
subtitle: Serving warm meals with dignity, compassion, and the love of Christ.
mission: Our soup kitchen exists to make sure no one in our community is forgotten. Each meal is a chance to nourish body and spirit, build relationships, and reflect Christ's mercy in practical ways.
schedule: Food Prep Team: Fridays, 4:30 PM - 6:00 PM

getInvolved.title: Serve On The Team
getInvolved.description: Join cooking, serving, setup, or cleanup teams once a week or once a month.

getInvolved.title: Donate Groceries
getInvolved.description: Contribute rice, soup mix, vegetables, cooking oil, bread, and long-life milk.

getInvolved.title: Support Financially
getInvolved.description: Financial gifts help us buy fresh ingredients and keep the ministry sustainable.
